name: bench-hljs
title: highlight.js' auto-detection test files, one or a few per language, without names
labels: highlight.js' maintainers (the test's directory, a language id), crosswalked to Linguist's names
sampling: curated (every auto-detection test file of a language)
strengths: content only: no file name, so every identifier is tested on the bytes
185 languages, one file each: no language dominates
independent of Linguist: no file is a Linguist sample
weaknesses: highlight.js' home turf: from 2014 to March 2024 its test suite required auto-detection to get every file right
short snippets written to show off a grammar, not files from real projects
one file per language: a per-language figure is a single file
